paragraphs: Rav Achadvoya bar Mattana said in Rav Mattana’s name. Rabbah bar Mattana, Rav Yehudah’s colleague, and his brother Rav Tuvi bar Mattana; Rabbah bar Mattana, Abaye’s colleague. The wording appears confused: it presents Rabbah bar Mattana as though he were Rav Achadvoya and Rav Tuvi’s brother. See Tuvi bar Mattana and Rabbah bar Mattana: Rabbah’s father was another Mattana; they are not one (see Mattana and what is written there). Rav Mattana said—some say Rav Achadvoya bar Mattana said—in Rav’s name, Shabbat 60, end of b. Rav Achadvoya said in Rav Mattana’s name in Rav’s name, Shabbat 24a—an error, since it should read Rav Achadvoya son of Rabbi Mattana, as Asheri has it.
